title: Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC
abstract: arXiv:2611.28654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach ex

translated_title: 无梯度Stein引导：超越粒子SMC的离散化一致扩散推理时间缩放
translated_abstract: 奖励引导的扩散模型需要对由近似价值函数引入的偏差进行有效引导与校正。一个布朗运动示例表明，每一步都执行完全多项式重采样的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法可能需要粒子数量随引导深度线性增长才能保持精度。我们提出了Stein引导方法，它将无导数引导与全路径独立性Metropolis-Hastings校正相结合。通过从中心化高斯候选中进行价值加权选择，可在期望意义下近似梯度引导，每步仅需少至两次查询。中心化处理稳定了局部归一化因子的估计，且同样的查询还能产生用于校正的显式路径权重。在一致的价值与空间正则性界限下，我们证明了有限网格总变差误差随MH更新次数呈超多项式衰减，且相关常数不随引导深度增长。当价值函数趋近精确时，误差前因子趋于零。
tldr: 提出Stein引导方法，将无导数引导与全路径Metropolis-Hastings校正相结合，每步仅需两次查询即可在期望意义下近似梯度引导，并证明误差随MH更新次数超多项式衰减且常数不随引导深度增长，突破了粒子SMC需粒子数随引导深度线性增长的限制。
en_tdlr: Stein Guidance combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction, approximating gradient guidance in expectation with as few as two queries per step and proving superpolynomial TV error decay with depth-independent constants, thereby surpassing particle SMC inference time scaling.
